claim: The Macie quota for preventative control monitoring is 10,000 S3 buckets per account; if an account exceeds it, Macie provides full monitoring functionality for the 10,000 buckets that were most recently created or changed, and for all other buckets it doesn't evaluate or monitor them for security and access control, generate policy findings, or maintain complete inventory data.

qualifiers.scope: per account, in each AWS Region

evidence.quote: If your account exceeds this quota, Macie provides full monitoring functionality for the 10,000 buckets that were most recently created or changed. For all other buckets, Macie doesn't evaluate or monitor the buckets for security and access control, generate policy findings, or maintain complete inventory data.
Unless otherwise noted, each quota applies to your account in each AWS Region.

note: d061. Up to 10,000 since 2024-12-06 (history row). adjudicate-09: kind changed from quota to restriction because the page does not say whether this quota can be increased.
